issues.detail: Session options expose a useChargingHistory window capped at 1,000 rows, but Inspect session contains no observed-window or limit explanation. The hook itself explicitly warns this is not lifetime coverage; the page does not communicate that distinction. Backend ordering and whether this vehicle reaches the cap are unknown.
issues.fix: Add localized history-window/source context beside the selector, preserving the exact limit and query/cache semantics; do not promise all/lifetime sessions or invent server pagination metadata.

visualAssessment.evidence: Scoped presentation scan found no explicit neon, glow, fixed-white styling, direct chart-library imports or static inline style attributes. Semantic badges, shared metric brief, chartTokens and shared surfaces are reused.
visualAssessment.preserve: Restrained semantic palette; no new hex palette, bright decorative gradients or metric-specific glow. Actual chart colors and composed contrast require browser verification.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature imports LayoutCard from layout/layout-reference despite an existing layout category export at components/layout/index.ts:11. ThermalTaxStats.tsx:5 similarly imports types from data-display/stat-reference even though category types are exported.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing layout and data-display category barrels for these available APIs; retain the same actual implementations and props.

architectureIssues.detail: useCardPlacement is imported through the internal layout-reference barrel. The inspected public layout category barrel does not export this hook, so this remaining dependency cannot simply be rewritten like LayoutCard.
architectureIssues.fix: Have the layout owner establish a category-exported placement read contract or approved public adapter; keep existing span/class semantics. Do not duplicate placement logic in the feature.

architectureIssues.detail: Chart rows discard tMs after sorting and retain only a localized hour/minute time label. ThermalPowerChart.tsx:41-47 exports those rows unchanged with a Time column; date, timezone and seconds are absent from CSV/fallback rows. Repeated clock times across dates or DST and samples within a minute are ambiguous.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain an exact timestamp in the presentation row and CSV/accessibility columns while preserving short axis labels, raw watts, sample order and null gaps. Use shared date-formatting policy rather than a new formatter; no calculator changes.

architectureIssues.detail: Session option formatDateShort is called without locale and its memo depends on sessions and t only; helper defaults to browser locale. Chart labels explicitly use i18n.language and phase dates pass that locale. App-selected language can therefore differ from selector dates.
architectureIssues.fix: Pass the existing locale-aware formatter options and include relevant locale dependency; preserve established timezone behavior unless the authoritative formatter owner requires a coordinated change.

priority.reason: This is already a composed modernization page with retained-data recovery and SI boundaries. Address source timestamp/export ambiguity and bounded-source communication before superficial restyling; category and locale cleanup are smaller follow-ups.
